name: Israel
summary: State established in 1948 whose military, intelligence, and diplomatic interventions have shaped modern Middle Eastern history, foreign occupations, regional wars, and cross-border operations.
historical_context: Since its founding in the 1948 war, Israel has conducted major conventional wars (1956, 1967, 1973, 1982) and sustained military occupations over Palestinian territories (West Bank, East Jerusalem, Gaza Strip) and the Syrian Golan Heights. Israel's foreign and defense policies, heavily subsidized by US diplomatic, military, and intelligence cooperation ($3.8B+ annually under bilateral MOUs), have encompassed covert operations, targeted assassinations, air campaigns across Arab states, and private security/surveillance technology exports globally.
primary_institutions_involved: Mossad (Institute for Intelligence and Special Operations)
